core_obligations: Affine reduction: irreducible components are affine-local; reduce to primes of the colimit ring.
V(p) computation: minimal primes of the colimit are limits of the minimal primes V(p_i) at finite levels; the limit of closed sets is computed on the ring side.
Kappa colimit: the residue field extension of the generic point of a component is the colimit of the finite-level residue field extensions.
proof_roadmap: Minimal primes as limits of V(p_i).
difficulty_reason: Affine reduction + V(p) limit computation + kappa colimit identification. Three clean steps.

compared.difference: The sibling computes the underlying set of the limit; this lemma computes its irreducible components and residue field extensions. Different objects over the same affine engine.
